issues.description: Method signature mismatch for SealSaloon.checkOrderReady(): The problem statement's UML (problem_statement.md) declares checkOrderReady() with return type void, but the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) declares public boolean checkOrderReady(). This difference in return type (void vs boolean) is a clear API inconsistency and may confuse students about the expected contract: whether the method should return a boolean indicating if any orders were served or be void and only perform side effects/printing.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent with the exercise specification. Preferred fix: change the solution implementation to 'public void checkOrderReady()' (and keep any boolean result as an internal local variable or expose it via a separate method if needed). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to declare checkOrderReady() as returning boolean and explain the meaning of the return value. Ensure any call sites are adjusted accordingly.
